query:
INSERT INTO issue_followers (id, issue_id, user_id, project_id)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, (SELECT project_id FROM issues WHERE id = $2))
            RETURNING
                id         AS "id!: Uuid",
                issue_id   AS "issue_id!: Uuid",
                user_id    AS "user_id!: Uuid",
                project_id AS "project_id!: Uuid"
